_about: Screen texts for the ten screens in CLAUDE.md 'Site rules'. Sentences of eight words or fewer, no science words (those live in glossary.json). {placeholders} are filled by the pipeline (fill_registry.json); 'when' names a condition in fill_registry.json. The site is text only: no audio (owner, 2026-11-12). Every Nepali text was drafted by SI (Claude) on 2026-11-12 and needs native-speaker review before export; each node carries ne_review until a reviewer replaces it with their name and date. Months (owner, 2026-11-12, choice 7): in Nepali each month key is named by the Bikram Sambat month that begins in it, about the middle of the Gregorian month, with the approximate Gregorian months beside it, e.g. 'Apr' = बैशाख (अप्रिल–मे), Gregorian names in Devanagari (owner's batch decisions item 22). They do not line up exactly (each BS month starts on a slightly different day each year; TODO-VERIFY the start days against a published Nepali calendar), so every screen that names a month carries 'months_note'. English stays Gregorian.

texts.en: Let's look at your field together.
We help you think. You decide.
We picked this field as an example.
texts.ne: हामीले यो खेत उदाहरणका लागि छानेका हौं।

texts.en: How each part of your field is doing.
Tap the four corners of your field.
Tap a corner again to move it.
We have not looked at this place yet.
texts.ne: हामीले यो ठाउँ अहिलेसम्म हेरेका छैनौं।

texts.en: Where does your field's water come from?
Is your field flat or on steps?
texts.ne: तपाईंको खेत समथर छ कि गरामा?

texts.en: This is a map, not a photo.
The line shows the sample field.
A real photo comes when we visit.
texts.ne: हामी खेतमा आएपछि साँचो फोटो आउँछ।

texts.en: We show our sample field near you.
texts.ne: हामी तपाईंको नजिकको नमुना खेत देखाउँछौं।

water.maps_to: config/fields/<id>.yaml water_source: rain-only, canal, well, irrigated (null = unknown); 'other' maps to irrigated

shape.maps_to: not stored yet; terraces would change rules.yaml curve_numbers (METHOD_NOTES.md item 8)

title.en: We looked at your field from space
title.ne: हामीले अन्तरिक्षबाट तपाईंको खेत हेरेका छौं

texts.en: From space, both look the same.
The ground is bare about {bare_days} days yearly.
texts.ne: वर्षमा करिब {bare_days} दिन जमिन खाली रहन्छ।

texts.en: Uncovered soil can wash away in rain.
Since {year_first}, rains start about {shift_days_abs} days earlier.
texts.ne: {year_first} यता वर्षा करिब {shift_days_abs} दिन चाँडै आउँछ।

texts.en: Since {year_first}, rains start about {shift_days_abs} days later.
texts.ne: {year_first} यता वर्षा करिब {shift_days_abs} दिन ढिलो आउँछ।

texts.en: The rains start about when they used to.
Water stored in this whole area is falling.
texts.ne: यो पूरै क्षेत्रमा जम्मा पानी घट्दै छ।

texts.en: Water stored in this whole area is steady.
texts.ne: यो पूरै क्षेत्रमा जम्मा पानी उस्तै छ।

texts.en: Water stored in this whole area is rising.
texts.ne: यो पूरै क्षेत्रमा जम्मा पानी बढ्दै छ।

texts.en: This trend is clear for the wide area.
texts.ne: ठूलो क्षेत्रका लागि यो चाल स्पष्ट छ।

texts.en: It does not tell about your own well.
This is the whole area, not your well.
texts.ne: यो पूरै क्षेत्रको कुरा हो, तपाईंको इनारको होइन।

texts.en: Nepali and English months don't line up exactly.
texts.ne: नेपाली र अंग्रेजी महिना ठ्याक्कै मिल्दैनन्।

texts.en: We may show too many freezing nights.
texts.ne: हामीले तुषारो धेरै देखाएका हुन सक्छौं।

texts.en: We are less sure about this month.
texts.ne: यो महिनाबारे हामी कम पक्का छौं।

frost.maps_to: diary.months[].frost (risk = nights 0 to 2 C, high = below 0 C)

texts.en: We split your field into {section_count} parts.
Tap a part to see it.
From space, nearby parts look the same.
The soil stick tells them apart.
texts.ne: माटो जाँच्ने यन्त्रले तिनको फरक देखाउँछ।

texts.en: How warm the soil is: {temp} degrees.
How sure we are: {sure_pct} out of 100.
Fog means we are not sure yet.
texts.ne: कुहिरोको अर्थ, हामी अझै पक्का छैनौं।

texts.en: A smiling face means all is well.
texts.ne: हाँसेको अनुहारको अर्थ सबै ठीक छ।

texts.en: A little greener than the rest.
A little less green than the rest.
Low ground: cold air can collect.
texts.ne: होचो जमिन: चिसो हावा जम्न सक्छ।

texts.en: All parts share one soil and weather.
texts.ne: सबै भागमा एउटै माटो र मौसम।

status.about: How each part is doing (always with a face and a mark, never colour alone)

texts.en: Push the soil stick into this part.
texts.ne: माटो जाँच्ने यन्त्र यो भागमा गाड्नुहोस्।

texts.en: Hold it still for a moment.
Space sees wide. Your stick sees close.
texts.ne: अन्तरिक्षले फराकिलो देख्छ। यन्त्रले नजिकबाट देख्छ।

texts.en: Together they make a better guess.
Watch a soil check we did earlier.
texts.ne: हामीले पहिले गरेको माटो जाँच हेर्नुहोस्।

texts.en: Our soil stick is a prototype.
texts.ne: हाम्रो माटो जाँच्ने यन्त्र परीक्षणकै नमुना हो।

texts.en: Today we carry it by hand.
A robot to carry it comes next.
texts.ne: यसलाई बोक्ने रोबोट अर्को चरणमा आउँछ।

texts.en: This shows how the robot will work.
texts.ne: रोबोटले कसरी काम गर्नेछ, यसले देखाउँछ।

texts.en: It reads only the top few centimetres.
texts.ne: यसले माथिको केही सेन्टिमिटर मात्र नाप्छ।

texts.en: Readings come after our team tests it.
The reading jumped. Please test again.
About the same as the others
Each basket is one year's harvest.
texts.ne: हरेक डोको एक वर्षको उब्जनी हो।

texts.en: A full basket is this field's best.
texts.ne: भरिएको डोको यो खेतको सबैभन्दा राम्रो उब्जनी हो।

texts.en: A computer copy of your field made these.
texts.ne: तपाईंको खेतको कम्प्युटर नमुनाले यी बनाएको हो।

texts.en: The crop was thirsty on {dry_days} days.
With water when needed, it looks like this.
texts.ne: चाहिएको बेला पानी दिँदा यस्तो हुन्थ्यो।

texts.en: We don't know your water yet.
texts.ne: हामीलाई तपाईंको पानीको स्रोत थाहा छैन।

texts.en: So we show both, side by side.

event.about: What the weather did that year. It is about the field, so it is the same on every plan (owner, 2026-11-13)

flood.en: Too much rain in one day

water_case.about: The two baskets for each year, side by side (owner, 2026-11-12)
water_case.maps_to: rain_fed = replay.<plan>[].harvest and dry_days while field.water_source is 'unknown' or 'rain-only'; irrigated = replay.<plan>[].irrigated. While field.water_source is 'unknown', show both side by side, each with its label (owner's batch decisions item 8, 2026-11-12)

event_season.about: Which season a drier year comes from, when it is one season only (owner, 2026-11-13)
event_season.maps_to: replay.<plan>[].event_season; only present with event 'drought'. Show it instead of the 'drought' words

texts.en: Three choices: what to grow, and when.
texts.ne: तीन विकल्प: के लगाउने, कहिले लगाउने।

texts.en: More drops, less worry about water.
Nepali and English months don't line up exactly.
texts.ne: नेपाली र अंग्रेजी महिना ठ्याक्कै मिल्दैनन्।

texts.en: Why do some crops help the soil?
texts.ne: केही बालीले माटोलाई किन मद्दत गर्छन्?

texts.en: Tap a choice to see why.
This assumes water never runs out.
Two ways of counting rain give a range.
texts.ne: वर्षा गन्ने दुई तरिकाले दायरा दिन्छन्।

texts.en: One matches the nearby town's usual rain.
texts.ne: एउटा नजिकको सहरको सामान्य वर्षासँग मिल्छ।

plan.maps_to: plans[].name for ids current, cover_gap, safest. The third plan is called 'Feed your soil' (owner, 2026-11-13, answer 3 to REVIEW_2; its id stays 'safest'); follow_shift is kept for a possible revisit after step 9's 2040 projections

priority.about: Answers to 'what matters most to you?'

texts.en: Nobody knows the future for sure.
Many computer guesses make this range.
texts.ne: धेरै कम्प्युटर अनुमानले यो दायरा बनाउँछन्।

texts.en: Try less rain or more heat.
texts.ne: कम पानी वा बढी गर्मी राखेर हेर्नुहोस्।

texts.en: Nepali and English months don't line up exactly.
texts.ne: नेपाली र अंग्रेजी महिना ठ्याक्कै मिल्दैनन्।
आफ्नो जमिन तपाईंलाई नै राम्रो थाहा छ।

texts.en: Talk to a farm advisor before changing.
Try it on one small part first.
texts.ne: पहिले एउटा सानो भागमा मात्र गरेर हेर्नुहोस्।

texts.en: Made with pictures and numbers from NASA.
A computer drafted many words here.
Nepali words still need a careful check.
texts.ne: नेपाली शब्द अझै राम्ररी जाँच्न बाँकी छ।

texts.en: A computer also helped find the seasons.
texts.ne: बाली याम खोज्न पनि कम्प्युटरले सघायो।

texts.en: We tested three ways on unseen years.
A real photo of the field.
Soil stick readings from the field.
Your own field: today we show a sample.
texts.ne: तपाईंको आफ्नै खेत: अहिले नमुना देखाउँछौं।

texts.en: The robot that carries the stick.
